classification_law.SATISFIED_CURRENT: Exact project-current binding/ref is positively owned and named by adopted upstream authority.
classification_law.SATISFIED_CANDIDATE_ONLY: Upstream fixes candidate semantic/evidentiary content, but no current contract-shaped concrete-rule ref/binding exists yet.
classification_law.MISSING: The contract requires an object/ref/disposition not supplied by the named adopted inputs.
classification_law.BLOCKED: An adopted holding or prerequisite prevents lawful closure without new competent authority/proof.
classification_law.NOT_APPLICABLE: Only where the contract itself makes the field inapplicable for the stated path/state; never inferred from absence.

requirement_matrix.requirement: Exact immutable non-selector rule id.
requirement_matrix.closure: Separately authorized concrete-rule construction must select an exact rule_id; R03 may not mint it.

requirement_matrix.requirement: Exact immutable non-range rule version.
requirement_matrix.closure: Select exact version; latest/default/range selectors are forbidden.

requirement_matrix.requirement: Lowercase SHA-256 binding exact concrete rule body.
requirement_matrix.closure: Freeze exact rule body first, then hash it; R03 may not invent the body/hash.

requirement_matrix.requirement: Nonempty exact P1-P5 class tuple.
requirement_matrix.basis: P03 adopts P1 MATERIAL_ACCESS_DEPENDENCY as the narrowest M10-M01 candidate class.
requirement_matrix.closure: Carry P1 only if future rule body remains within the adopted M10-M01 meaning; widening requires new adjudication.

requirement_matrix.requirement: Exact constitution-current-selection ExactRef independent of rule currentness.
requirement_matrix.basis: HQ runtime adoption 73f33a8a4c185c46faec5ac47332153ca079ca5f makes the R4 package project-current, but a commit SHA is not silently retyped as this ExactRef.
requirement_matrix.closure: Supply the exact immutable constitution-current-selection ExactRef for the concrete envelope.

requirement_matrix.requirement: Nonempty tuple of exact source ExactRefs.
requirement_matrix.closure: Materialize contract-shaped source ExactRef(s); raw commit/blob identities remain evidence until typed by competent authority.

requirement_matrix.requirement: Nonempty tuple of exact claim ExactRefs.
requirement_matrix.basis: P03 fixes M10-M01 and Wright Ch.3 supplied loci 857-909, 951-959, 978-996; Q03 preserves those claims.
requirement_matrix.closure: Issue immutable claim ExactRef(s); citation/locus prose alone is not the contract-shaped claim ref.

requirement_matrix.requirement: Exact evidence-status/ceiling ref.
requirement_matrix.basis: M10 ledger explicitly says extraction/adjudication evidence is not automatic architecture authority; P03 adopts that ceiling.
requirement_matrix.closure: Freeze that status as an ExactRef without widening source evidence into causal-use or rule authority.

requirement_matrix.requirement: Exact normalized-mechanism ref.
requirement_matrix.basis: P03 fixes the bounded M10-M01 kernel and P1 class.
requirement_matrix.closure: Freeze claim-bounded normalized-mechanism ExactRef preserving P1 ceiling and no P5/topology/person widening.

requirement_matrix.requirement: Exact permitted concrete rule-shape ref.
requirement_matrix.basis: P03 supplies a documentary kernel but explicitly mints no concrete rule; Q01 owns future semantic-shape adjudication only.
requirement_matrix.closure: Competent rule-shape adjudication must freeze the permitted shape as an ExactRef before rule-body hashing.

requirement_matrix.requirement: Exact ref covering required objective inputs and counterpart/binding requirements.
requirement_matrix.basis: P03 requires insufficient productive assets + active wage position + employer/counterpart binding; Q03 admits a semantic position candidate only.
requirement_matrix.closure: Freeze exact objective-input/binding ref. Actor-indexed Q03 position input still needs independent qualification/materialization; R01 provisional output is not consumed.

requirement_matrix.requirement: Exact qualification/realization proof-contract ref.
requirement_matrix.basis: HQ says Q03 independent position qualification/materialization is not yet satisfied; R03 may not consume R01 provisional output.
requirement_matrix.closure: Supply project-current proof-contract ExactRef and later only adopted qualification evidence.

requirement_matrix.requirement: Exact temporal/currentness contract ref.
requirement_matrix.closure: Supply exact valid-time/as-of/currentness contract ref for the concrete rule.

requirement_matrix.requirement: Exact portability ceiling ref.
requirement_matrix.basis: M10 evidence is historically/institutionally qualified and does not establish universal portability.
requirement_matrix.closure: Supply exact portability ceiling; absence never means universal portability.

requirement_matrix.requirement: Exact currentness-noncollapse ceiling ref.
requirement_matrix.basis: P03 preserves CONSTITUTION CURRENT != RULE CURRENT != APPLICATION CURRENT != FACT CURRENT != WITNESS CURRENT; HQ says no rule/topology current.
requirement_matrix.closure: Freeze that noncollapse as exact currentness-ceiling ExactRef.

requirement_matrix.requirement: Exact historical/institutional-validity ref.
requirement_matrix.basis: M10 conditions the relation on asset/property/institutional rules; Q03 requires exact institutional-rule context.
requirement_matrix.closure: Freeze historical/institutional validity bounds as an ExactRef; no present-day persistence inference.

requirement_matrix.requirement: Exact negative-ceiling ref.
requirement_matrix.basis: Q01 forbids CAUSAL_USE/current-rule/topology widening; Q03 forbids mechanism/topology/causal/person promotion; M10 forbids direct person inference.
requirement_matrix.closure: Consolidate applicable ceilings into one immutable rule-envelope ExactRef without weakening upstream prohibitions.

requirement_matrix.requirement: Exact V3 stop-boundary ref.
requirement_matrix.basis: P03/Q01/Q03/HQ preserve PRE-V3 objective-world-only and no person-state semantics.
requirement_matrix.closure: Freeze the adopted stop boundary as an exact rule-trace ExactRef; V3/person evidence cannot satisfy objective-rule requirements.

requirement_matrix.requirement: Mandatory BOUND RULE_OWNER with exact scope, AuthorityRef and nonempty authority-current-selection evidence.
requirement_matrix.closure: No residual RULE_OWNER work while future rule remains within Q01 exact scope.

requirement_matrix.requirement: Explicit MEASUREMENT AuthorityCeilingBinding: BOUND with AuthorityRef+selection evidence or NOT_APPLICABLE with exact N/A-basis ref.
requirement_matrix.closure: Competent authority must explicitly choose disposition; absence is not NOT_APPLICABLE.

requirement_matrix.requirement: Explicit ESTIMAND AuthorityCeilingBinding: BOUND with AuthorityRef+selection evidence or NOT_APPLICABLE with exact N/A-basis ref.
requirement_matrix.closure: Competent authority must explicitly choose disposition; absence is not NOT_APPLICABLE.

requirement_matrix.requirement: Explicit IDENTIFICATION AuthorityCeilingBinding: BOUND with AuthorityRef+selection evidence or NOT_APPLICABLE with exact N/A-basis ref.
requirement_matrix.closure: Competent authority must explicitly choose disposition; absence is not NOT_APPLICABLE.

requirement_matrix.requirement: Mandatory BOUND CAUSAL_USE with exact scope, competent AuthorityRef and nonempty authority-current-selection evidence.
requirement_matrix.closure: Competent external causal-use owner must supply exact M10-M01 authority, scope and selection evidence. SOURCE_CITATION != CAUSAL_USE_AUTHORITY; P1_CLASS_MEMBERSHIP != CLAIM_SPECIFIC_CAUSAL_USE_AUTHORITY. R03 does not consume W16 R02.

requirement_matrix.requirement: NUMERIC requires BOUND current CALIBRATION authority; NONNUMERIC requires explicit CALIBRATION NOT_APPLICABLE with exact N/A-basis ref.
requirement_matrix.closure: Close only after value_mode is frozen; no calibration disposition may be inferred from prose.

requirement_matrix.requirement: Exact RuleValueMode NUMERIC or NONNUMERIC.
requirement_matrix.basis: Current source/P03 kernel is qualitative, but no concrete rule body is minted.
requirement_matrix.closure: Concrete rule-shape construction must explicitly freeze NUMERIC vs NONNUMERIC; R03 does not infer NONNUMERIC from prose.

requirement_matrix.requirement: Exact enum CANDIDATE_NOT_CURRENT, CURRENT_ACCEPTED or HISTORICAL_NONCURRENT.
requirement_matrix.basis: HQ terminal says NO_RULE_OR_TOPOLOGY_CURRENT; R03 forbids CURRENT_ACCEPTED.
requirement_matrix.closure: At this frontier any first assembled rule may only remain CANDIDATE_NOT_CURRENT; future CURRENT_ACCEPTED needs independent selection.

requirement_matrix.requirement: Nonempty exact independent rule-current-selection refs for CURRENT_ACCEPTED.
requirement_matrix.basis: HQ says residual envelope closure/independent rule-current-selection is not yet proved; contract requires nonempty refs; R03 forbids CURRENT_ACCEPTED.
requirement_matrix.closure: Only after rule identity and all mandatory envelope bindings close may a separately competent selector issue these refs; Q01 authority currentness/source citation cannot substitute.

requirement_matrix.requirement: Empty for CANDIDATE_NOT_CURRENT/CURRENT_ACCEPTED; nonempty with prior selection only for HISTORICAL_NONCURRENT.
requirement_matrix.basis: No prior current M10-M01 concrete rule exists; CANDIDATE_NOT_CURRENT carries no current or historical disposition proof.
requirement_matrix.closure: No ref now. If a previously-current rule is later retired, both prior selection and noncurrent disposition refs become mandatory.

Competent external M10-M01 CAUSAL_USE AuthorityRef + exact scope + nonempty authority-current-selection evidence.
Explicit BOUND or NOT_APPLICABLE dispositions with exact contract material; calibration follows value_mode.
Lift already-fixed constitution/source/claim/evidence/input/currentness/historical/negative/V3-stop material into exact contract-shaped refs without widening.

After complete valid concrete envelope exists, separately competent selector may issue nonempty exact rule-current-selection evidence.
